verdict.rationale: Privacy posture is a fair question for a payroll and HR SaaS that holds sensitive data, so the axis applies. The pack contains no Gusto policy, setting, or opt-out that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: MCP connection scoping controls which data categories an LLM can access, and the CLI's GUSTO_TELEMETRY=0 drops usage headers. Neither one prevents data from being used to train models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
